name: host-ask-across-restart-never-stale
description: Teams Phase 2 (E, the stale negative): support's ask is pending when billing's generation 1 ends. Its end append refuses the ask (mail_refused{member_ended}, the row returned) and bounces it to the caller with the result; the supervisor restarts generation 2. The ask closes member_ended; no mail is ever stale, since a sender binds the current generation and an end refuses every pending row.
